messages.content:
You are reading a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) to decide whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis).

<document>
<document 30 omitted, sha256 16000b8b667016d8>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some third-parties (including consultants, agents and professional advisors).
</hypothesis>

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide. Choose this when you are unsure whether the document covers the point; do not guess.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give the passages of the document your label rests on as a list of quotes. Each quote must be copied character for character from the document: no paraphrase, no ellipses, no added words, no changed punctuation. A quote may be a whole sentence or part of one; give 1 to 3 quotes, each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. A program will check every quote against the document, and a reading with a quote that is not in the document counts as a failed reading. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is the correct one. Use the whole range; 90 or above means you would expect to be wrong less than one time in ten.

Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label": "Contradiction", "confidence": 62, "quotes": ["the Confidential Information may not be disclosed by the Receiving Party to its professional advisors on a need-to-know basis", "will not disclose it to any third party for any reason or purpose whatsoever without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party"], "reason": "Clause 3.4 expressly states Confidential Information may not be disclosed to professional advisors, and clause 3.3 bars disclosure to any third party without prior written consent."}
